coverage_assessment: Eighteen one-query web calls captured 496 result title/URL/ref headers across 281 unique URL source cards. Search coverage includes all four January weeks, English and Swahili/Luganda terms, Kampala and other regions/sectors, plus December 2020/February 2021 physical continuity. Six article bodies were returned (HRW is quarantined; VOA, Peoples Dispatch, Guardian, Daily Monitor, and the Fiji Times Reuters report were read); New Vision returned HTTP 200 but only title metadata, with no substantive paragraphs/date. AP and Uganda Radio Network bodies are blocked after HTTP 403. Two candidates remain pending review: E001 is a Jan 22 nationwide call with no executed gathering; E002 is one Reuters account of Jan 16 protests in Luwero and Masaka, with reported deaths/arrests but no attendance or venue and unresolved one-versus-two unit. Three gaps remain. Baseline, archive/language coverage and event thresholds are incomplete. No absence or exhaustiveness claim.
